verdict.rationale: Babylon.js has a first-party package and tooling ecosystem: modular NPM packages with substantial download volume, exporter plugins for 3ds Max, Maya and Blender, physics-engine integrations, and editors such as the Node Material Editor, Playground, Inspector and Sandbox. Nothing in the pack shows an asset store or marketplace of ready-made models or third-party plugins, and one user reports finding no active community outside Microsoft-run channels. Missing for 10: an asset store or marketplace of ready-made models, a third-party plugin ecosystem, and independent evidence that the ecosystem is large.
